events.title: US-Japan coordinated yen intervention: US sold euros to buy yen, ECB blindsided
events.summary: US Treasury and Japan MOF conducted rare coordinated intervention (~$75B Japan, $5-10B US). US sold EUROS instead of dollars to avoid destabilizing Treasury markets. ECB was not informed beforehand. Bessent urging Fed to expand FIMA repo backstop. Yen hit 40-year low before intervention. Markets pricing September BOJ hike to 1.25%.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz crisis: Iran attacks on shipping ongoing 5+ months, talks stalling
events.summary: Iranian attacks on commercial shipping have disrupted Hormuz traffic for 5+ months. Iran launched retaliatory missile/drone strikes on US embassies, military installations, oil infrastructure. Brent spiked 10-13%. US-Iran talks ongoing but Iran tempering optimism. State Dept sanctioned 6 entities for Iran crypto funding.

events.title: Ebola epidemic: Fastest-growing outbreak on record, 4,209 cases, 1,916 deaths, WHO PHEIC
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC/Uganda. 4,209 confirmed cases, 1,916 deaths as of Aug 7. Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. No certified treatments for Bundibugyo species. WHO declared PHEIC. US pledged $242M. ECDC monitoring for imported cases.

events.title: China property crisis: 10 quarters of deflation, nationwide economic emergency
events.source: Chiang Rai Times, The Tribune, Wikipedia
events.summary: China has recorded 10 consecutive quarters of deflationary pressure. Property sector mutated from developer problem to nationwide economic emergency. PBOC tightening liquidity. New global asset tax on super-rich signals fiscal distress.

events.title: France fiscal crisis: EUR107B H1 deficit, 8% deficit ratio, new Eurozone debt epicenter
events.source: Futunn, The Corner, ECB Economic Bulletin
events.summary: France central govt deficit EUR107B in H1 2026, 14.4% higher YoY. Full-year deficit ratio potentially 8%. New epicenter of Eurozone debt crisis. ECB forward curve pricing 40bp of hikes by end-2026.

events.title: Gold at $4,304-4,360/oz: First real break of 1980 inflation-adjusted record
events.summary: Gold spot at $4,304-4,360/oz. 2026 highs above $5,000 represent first genuine break of 1980 record in real inflation-adjusted terms. DXY below 100.

events.title: Colombia 7.4 magnitude earthquake, 111 killed near Venezuela border
events.summary: 7.4 magnitude earthquake in Colombia, 111 killed. Adds to LatAm instability alongside Argentina peso crisis (country risk 451bp) and Brazil-Argentina diplomatic crisis.
